runner_decision_checklist.headline: What to know before you head to Shelby Park.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A quick runner checklist for packet pickup, start time, course support, shirts, and race-day rules.

items.label: Packet pickup
items.detail: Race-morning packet pickup begins at 6:00 AM before both races get underway at 7:30 AM.

items.label: Start time
items.detail: RunSignup lists both the 15K Run and the 5K Run/Walk from 7:30 AM CDT to 10:00 AM CDT.

items.label: Shirt deadline
items.detail: The listing says shirts are guaranteed if registered before October 2, 2026.

items.label: Hydration plan
items.detail: Hydration is available in the start/finish area. The 15K has course hydration; the 5K does not list course hydration.

items.label: Price increase
items.detail: Both events are currently listed at $27.50 including the $2.50 fee, with the next price increase after July 17, 2026 at 11:59 PM CDT.

items.label: Course rule
items.detail: The public listing states no dogs and no pets are allowed.

story.title: A Nashville Striders fall race morning in Shelby Park.
paragraphs: Shelby Bottoms Boogie brings runners and walkers to Shelby Park for Nashville Striders’ 26th annual fall running event. The 15K and 5K share a start/finish and use certified routes through Shelby Park and the Shelby Bottoms Greenway.
The event is built for a straightforward race morning: ample free parking, race-morning packet pickup, RunSignup-based race-day registration, and post-race snacks at the finish.
story.quote: Both the 15K and 5K feature certified courses in Shelby Park and along the Shelby Bottoms Greenway with a common Start / Finish.

faqs.question: Where is the race?
faqs.answer: The race is listed at Shelby Park, start/finish near the dripping bird statue, 1600 Davidson Street, Nashville, TN 37206.

faqs.question: What events are offered?
faqs.answer: RunSignup lists a Shelby Bottoms Boogie 15K Run and a Shelby Bottoms Boogie 5K Run/Walk.

faqs.question: When do the races start?
faqs.answer: Both the 15K and 5K Run/Walk are listed as starting at 7:30 AM CDT.

faqs.question: When is packet pickup?
faqs.answer: Race-morning packet pickup begins at 6:00 AM.

faqs.question: Are pets allowed?
faqs.answer: No. The public listing states no dogs and no pets allowed.

faqs.question: How does race-day registration work?
faqs.answer: Race-day registration is listed as available through RunSignup only, with no cash transactions onsite on race day.
